trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** — Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only staging) and rolled back all regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified** — checkout-api is now healthy in all three regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident** — SEV2 incident **INC-0001** opened for checkout-api documenting the failure and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged to investigate the v2.3.1 regression.
